actions: الإنهاء القسري والحيوية والتعليق أثناء القفل (السيناريو 8، R-40)

ABI v1.11: process_kill(h) with WRITE on the process handle (spawn hands it out), EXIT_KILLED; the kill takes effect at safe points (syscall exit, blocking waits, the return to ring 3 from an interrupt) on any CPU
services.md v1.7: STOP grace then process_kill; watchdog=<ticks> in the manifest: PING/PONG on the boot channel, a missed period kills and the restart policy applies

session.md v1.1: requests to display/input carry a deadline (REQUEST_DEADLINE = 5000 ticks) — a hung component is treated as lost, never waited on forever (TST-M5-SESSION-DEADLINE); display and input answer PING (v1.7). Scope decision 2026-10-19: the session itself does not answer PING in v1.1 — a session watchdog must outlast REQUEST_DEADLINE, and that interplay is designed with the real boot manifest (M6); declared in session.md §8. Requests to auth stay unbounded (declared, session.md §8)
ktest fault: freeze a process by name (test kernel only); process names kept for diagnostics
tests: TST-M5-PROCESS-KILL, TST-M5-KILL-EDGES, TST-M5-SVC-WATCHDOG, TST-M5-LOCK-HANG

Review fixes 2026-10-19 (Docs review K1–K4, S1–S7, R4): kernel — a pending kill refuses a block or sleep under the scheduler lock (K1), a killed process reports EXIT_KILLED whatever its own exit code (K2), a frozen process's timed waits do not expire (ktest only, K3), an atomic pending-kill count spares the lock on the common path and the freeze check is ktest-only (K4); services.md v1.8 — a gone boot channel or an undeliverable PING is a hang, a passed watchdog deadline is always re-armed or cleared, queued PONGs are read before judging, a readiness timeout forces the process after STOP_GRACE, a service being killed is not ready, spaces after watchdog=<n> are separators, and an unsolicited PONG is a declared limit (S1–S7); tests — TST-M5-KILL-EDGES (new), PROCESS-KILL settles each child and checks the refused kill left it alive, PEER_CLOSED and a sleeping child, SVC-WATCHDOG adds a channel closer, an early hanger, a two-space line, a PONG count and a STOP grace lower bound, LOCK-HANG checks restarts=0 before the freezes and caps the spawn counts

Honesty audit 2026-10-19 (CI run 39189093802): PROCESS-KILL, SVC-WATCHDOG and LOCK-HANG (compositor then input frozen while locked) PASS; REQ-M5-010 stays partial because its named failure case — the session waiting on a hung component's reply — is untested and session.md v1.1 was not written. Council verdict: first establish from the code whether the session can block on a display/input reply; then TST-M5-SESSION-HANG (freeze while the session's request is in flight; session keeps serving, lock holds, no key leaks, screendump shows only the lock screen, only the right password unlocks) and session.md v1.1 either way; the session gets PING only with a test that kills it while locked and proves the ADR-0019 §5 rescue; then amend REQ-M5-010's acceptance and close
records.acceptance: its five tests (PROCESS-KILL, KILL-EDGES, SVC-WATCHDOG, LOCK-HANG, SESSION-DEADLINE) PASS on CI with every earlier suite green; R-40 recorded as RSK-009 (mitigated); what the M5 pre-gate review found beyond it (lock with the compositor already down, a request in flight while locked) is WP-43's

actions: تقوية M5 بعد مراجعة ما قبل البوابة (2026-10-19)

M1: a message too large for a server's buffer is discarded with an error (displayd, svcmgr, inputd), never left at the head of the queue — test: one client sends 2000 bytes, another's STATUS is answered within 500 ticks

M2: the narrator role only for a service the manifest names; no per-keystroke announcement from a password field — test: the spy asks NARRATOR and is refused, and hears nothing from the session's window
M3: a client's LIST hash covers its own surface, not the composited pixels, and nothing while it is held — test: during the lock, the spy's hash does not change while the password is typed
M5: the screen is covered when the session locks with the compositor down or hung — test: stop the compositor while unlocked, lock, the screendump shows no application pixel
M6: ZWJ/ZWNJ stay inside the Arabic run in layout — test: layout output equals HarfBuzz on the ZWJ/ZWNJ cases
M7: Alt+Tab visits every window in a stable order — test: three windows, three presses visit all three, a minimised one included
M9: the session's own loss — test: drop the session while locked and after unlock; focus cleared, screen held, a new session starts at no_session

S-5: input reserves the display name for the compositor's manager identity; S-6: after a compositor restart while unlocked the keyboard goes back to it; S-7: per-client window and surface limits — each with a test
records.acceptance: each finding has a test that fails before its fix and passes after on CI; then REQ-M5-002, -004 and -006 return to verified_in_scope
